summary: Iter34 — Tested DB Snapshots (export/import/edit/delete), shared contacts visibility helper, and Contacts.jsx Société datalist autocomplete. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases PASSED (snapshot CRUD, gzip+JSON structure, smtp_password masking '***MASKED***', dry-run no-mutation w/ action='dry-run', merge upsert with after>=before, imports history, RBAC 401/403 for non-admin, /me/contacts admin still works, delete removes row + physical file via 404 on download). Frontend: ALL 7 acceptance criteria PASSED. (1) /admin/settings shows [data-testid='admin-db-snapshots-section'] with 'NOUVEAU' bubble. (2) Search bar 'Sauvegarde' filters the new section correctly. (3) [data-testid='snapshot-create-btn'] created a snapshot and the history table refreshed automatically with the new row. (4) Pencil icon [data-testid='snapshot-edit-btn-{id}'] opens inline input + [data-testid='snapshot-edit-save-{id}'] persists the new comment (toast 'Commentaire mis à jour'). (5) [data-testid='snapshot-download-{id}'] triggered a Playwright download event for 'snapshot_{id}.json.gz' (verified blob/filename). (6) [data-testid='snapshot-delete-{id}'] after browser confirm removes the row (toast 'Snapshot supprimé', verified row no longer in DOM). (7) Import card visible with [data-testid='snapshot-import-mode'] select (replace/merge), [data-testid='snapshot-import-dryrun'] checkbox, [data-testid='snapshot-import-comment'] field, [data-testid='snapshot-import-file-input'] file input, and [data-testid='snapshot-import-btn'] button. (8) /portal/contacts modal: 'Société (client)' field is now an HTML <input list='contact-company-options'> with [data-testid='contact-field-company'] and an associated <datalist id='contact-company-options'> populated with options — free-text 'Acme Test' entry accepted; suggestions render via native browser datalist. No regressions on /me/contacts admin path. NOTE: per instructions, ONLY dry-run + merge modes tested on the preview — no replace mode triggered, no production data loss.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3066-3085 _build_snapshot_payload(): correctly applies mask_secrets ONLY to 'settings' collection — preserves user password hashes by design (as stated in the docstring). Iterates SNAPSHOT_COLLECTIONS deterministically; missing collections in DB are silently empty. Good.

server.py L3088-3131 _apply_snapshot(): merge mode uses {email:...} as natural key for 'users' and {id:...} elsewhere. Edge case: if a 'users' incoming row lacks email but has id, it falls through to insert_one (line 3118) without upsert — could create duplicate when re-importing. Minor — only an issue for malformed snapshots.

server.py L3216-3263 admin_import_snapshot(): tries gzip first then plain JSON; reasonable. Body validates 'collections' presence but does NOT validate 'version'. If a future v2 snapshot format ships, no version-gate is enforced — recommend adding `if payload.get('version') not in (1,)` check.

server.py L3201-3213 admin_delete_snapshot(): swallows file.unlink() exceptions silently. If the file is locked/permission-denied the metadata is still deleted, leaving an orphan .gz on disk. Consider logging the failure for ops visibility.

server.py L7887-7916 _resolve_visible_client_ids(): properly case-insensitive regex match on 'company'; falls back to [user.id] when ids set is empty. Good. One thing to watch: re.escape protects against regex injection — but if company contains a literal '$' or '%' MongoDB still treats it as a literal post-escape. Safe.

AdminSettings.jsx L1418-1528 DbSnapshotsSection: clean separation of create/list/edit/delete/import flows. window.confirm() used twice — acceptable for an admin-only destructive action. The fileInputRef pattern is idiomatic. No memory leaks (URL.revokeObjectURL called on line 1471).

AdminSettings.jsx L1505-1507: 'replace' mode triggers a window.confirm with strong warning copy — good UX safeguard. Note however that this guard is bypassed if dry_run is true (correct) but ALSO is bypassed for 'merge' which is fine but slightly inconsistent — merge could still overwrite existing rows. Consider a milder confirm for merge too.

Contacts.jsx L706-720: input + datalist pattern is the simplest accessible autocomplete. The

hint 'Tapez quelques lettres…' is good UX. companyOpts source not verified here — make sure it filters duplicates and is alphabetically sorted upstream.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest path: /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_snapshots.py — reusable as regression suite. Per E1 instructions, DO NOT trigger snapshot import in 'replace' mode on the preview — only 'merge' + dry_run are safe. The 'replace' confirm UX exists but bypassing it would wipe all 36 SNAPSHOT_COLLECTIONS. For visibility tests: only admin path verified here; to truly validate the cross-company sharing helper (_resolve_visible_client_ids) you must create two tracked users with the same `company` string then check that /me/contacts returns identical sets — requires admin UI to create non-admin users which was out of scope for this iter test (no API to create users without going through full admin flow). Frontend datalist test uses INPUT tag + list attribute checks; the actual native browser dropdown cannot be opened programmatically by Playwright on all browsers — we verified the contract (input+datalist binding) instead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Iter34 snapshot system, shared contacts visibility helper, and Contacts datalist autocomplete are fully functional in both backend and frontend.
